# $LogFile sample

`narcos-sysreserved-head.LogFile` is the first 164 KiB of `$LogFile` from the System Reserved volume of the 2019 Narcos
scenario image (Digital Corpora, `Narcos-CCleaner.E01`, Windows 10): the two restart pages and every record page in use.
The rest of the 4 MiB file is pages of `0xFF`, which were never written.
